description: Ruled Gochara kernel convention and its independent verifier restatements.

entries.justification: Retains the pre-existing legacy nodal convention used by the served Gochara grammar. The committed century contract pins this source through the ka_gochara_v5 writer dependency digest. The legacy nodal values and the governed kernel convention are tested independently.

SPECIAL_DRISHTI_DEG is the DELIBERATE pinned doctrine for the new gochara kernel, not an oracle bypass: WP1_CONTRACTS.md §7 + §2.2 N-14 (RULED) — Rāhu/Ketu cast NO dṛṣṭi (empty angle set), superseding the served nodal entries (F-29). brahmagyan.aspects.get_graha_aspects() carries the OPPOSITE nodal convention ('Rahu/Ketu cast the same special aspects as Jupiter', aspects.py:26), so importing it would violate the N-14 ruling. B-02 migration would require an oracle-side doctrinal change first; out of this lane's scope.

DELIBERATE independent restatement, not an oracle bypass: the gochara verifier re-derives the builder's output from the spec text and imports nothing from the builder (ND-ROLES option A; independent re-derivation is the point of a separate verifier — importing the shared oracle would make the check agree with the builder by construction).
